reports.subject: After pressing equals (which sets operator=null but leaves previousValue holding the old result), typing a new digit and then an operator does not update previousValue from the new currentEntry because selectOperator's `state.previousValue === null` guard at line 76 is false, so the calculator silently computes using the stale prior result (e.g. 5+3=8, then typing 2 and + then 3 and = yields 11 instead of the expected 5, i.e. 2+3).

applyPendingOperator stores raw IEEE-754 arithmetic results without rounding (e.g. entering 0.1 + 0.2 = displays '0.30000000000000004'), which fails AC-007's requirement that decimal values be computed and displayed correctly in an entirely ordinary calculation.
